_comment: Engram configuration. Replace {AGENT_ID} and {COLLECTION_NAME} with your values. Replace sonnet-4-6 with your model ids. See SKILL.md for full docs.

models._comment: Model ids for heartbeat subagents. Set 'default' to your preferred model — all subagents will use it unless overridden in heartbeat.subagents.

heartbeat._comment: Per-label overrides. Only set labels that need a different model from 'default'. Labels: hb-extract, hb-synthesis, hb-domains, hb-domains-write, hb-rethink, hb-rethink2, hb-autoresearch

cron._comment: Heartbeat schedule. Use cron expression (UTC). Avoid overlapping slots if running multiple workspaces. See AGENTS.md §5 for slot table.
